notes: Checked: C = 100/(1 - 0.5*0.75) = 160 pF; dQ = 60 pF x 12 V = 0.72 nC. R answers: 60 pF x 15.5 V = 0.93 nC, x 19.5 V = 1.17 nC, x 33 V = 1.98 nC, all match. Minimal pairs T8799/T9341 and T970C/T6AD3 share 7.5 V and wording, differing only in attachment. T27DA and T0DBA are declared numeral-free controls, which resolves my pass-1 concern about their missing number. Scene clause (lamp with own battery) is disconnected and consistent.
